recent_tweets.text:
exploring ways to spin up agents from my phone

iOS shortcuts × github actions × cursor cli

world_signals: late august dusk in san francisco, thirteen degrees and mostly clear
python interpreters wrapped in go, crossing language borders
text learning to read itself aloud, word by word
conway's cells still pulsing on thirty-year-old windows screens
iceland standing alone at the edge of europe
a lake sign planted where water meets sky

composer-2.5-fast.concept: Flip living cells on a shrinking retro grid to keep patterns alive — tap dead squares to birth, tap living ones to kill, survive accelerating generations before the board collapses.
composer-2.5-fast.session_hook: discovering a stable oscillator freezes the grid for three seconds and reveals a hidden glider
composer-2.5-fast.escalation: grid shrinks each wave, birth/death rules mutate, rogue cells spawn at edges
composer-2.5-fast.aesthetic: amber phosphor CRT pixel grid, Windows 3.1 dialog chrome

gpt-5.5-extra-high.concept: Narrate a scrolling sentence by tapping when the highlight lands on the emphasized syllable — miss the beat and the reader skips ahead, losing meaning.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.session_hook: perfect streaks unlock whispered asides that reveal hidden subtext between the lines
gpt-5.5-extra-high.escalation: reading speed increases, homographs and line breaks trick your timing
gpt-5.5-extra-high.aesthetic: sepia book margins with ink bleeding at the edges

claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.concept: Flick interpreter blocks across a chasm onto the correct runtime platform — python lands on Monty, go lands on compiled, mismatches shatter and cost a life.
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.session_hook: a perfect cross-language bridge triggers an absurd celebration animation and doubles the score
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.escalation: platforms drift, wind gusts push mid-flight, blocks grow heavier each round
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.aesthetic: flat blueprint vector with language logos as floating islands

gemini-3.1-pro.concept: Hold to sweep a lighthouse beam across a dusk lake — release when the light hits the correct buoy before the giant horizon sign fades.
gemini-3.1-pro.session_hook: hitting three buoys in sequence paints the lakeside sign letter by letter on the skyline
gemini-3.1-pro.escalation: fog rolls in narrowing the beam, buoys drift, false reflections lure wrong releases
gemini-3.1-pro.aesthetic: muted watercolor lake at dusk with oversized roadside sign silhouette
